codeSnippets.title: Basic Usage
codeSnippets.code:
import { BottomNavigation, BottomNavItem } from '@oneui/ui';

<BottomNavigation aria-label="Primary navigation" defaultValue="home">
  <BottomNavItem value="home" icon="home" label="Home" />
  <BottomNavItem value="search" icon="search" label="Search" />
</BottomNavigation>

interactionBehavior.summary: The whole equal-width column is the affordance: `.itemInner` has `pointer-events: none`, so taps land on the outer `<button>` or `<a>` rather than the icon or label. Hover and press tint that inner pill — not the full column — with the surrounding Surface's `--Hover` / `--Pressed`, independent of the item's accent role. Active is a current-route state (`aria-current="page"`), not a hover: the label steps to `--{Role}-High`, the icon to `--{Role}-TintedA11y`, and an optional `activeIcon` swaps in, with no selected fill. Press also scales the icon UP (`--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up`, 14%), the opposite of Button.
hover: Pointer hover fills only the inner pill (`.itemInner`) with `--BottomNavItem-backgroundColor-hover` → `--_bn-hover`, which is the Surface-injected `--{SurfaceRole}-Hover` (Neutral on a page canvas) — not `--{Role}-Hover` of the item's own appearance.
Label and icon colours do not change on hover; truncation also stays put — selected / focus / hover must not expand a 1-line ellipsis.
Wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)` and `:not([data-disabled])`, so a touch tap never leaves a stuck pill fill.
press: Holding the item fills the same inner pill with `--BottomNavItem-backgroundColor-pressed` → `--_bn-pressed` (the Surface role's `--Pressed`). This is NOT `(hover: hover)`-guarded, so a tap gets the fill immediately.
The icon slot scales UP: `scale(1 + var(--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up, 14) / 100)`. The label does not move. This is the same direction as Checkbox / Radio, opposite Button.
Inside a BottomNavigation, `onClick` fires first; `onValueChange` then runs unless `preventDefault` was called. `disabled` short-circuits both.
focus: Keyboard focus draws the two-layer halo on the inner pill, not the outer column: `--Stroke-XL` gap in `--Surface-Halo-Gap` plus an outer `--Focus-Outline` ring, so it stays legible inside a tinted `<Surface>`.
`:focus` on the item only clears the native outline; the ring is `:focus-visible`, so a mouse click does not paint it.
Inside BottomNavigation, Base UI Toolbar gives only one item `tabIndex={0}` at a time; the others are `-1` and are reached by arrows, not Tab.
keyboard: Without `href`, the item is a `<button>` (or Base UI `Toolbar.Button`), so `Enter` and `Space` both activate it and update the parent's `value`. Tests confirm each key fires `onValueChange` exactly once.
With `href`, it is a `Toolbar.Link` (`<a>`); `Enter` follows the destination. Arrow / `Home` / `End` behaviour is owned by the parent BottomNavigation toolbar, not this item.
A standalone BottomNavItem (no BottomNavigation toolbar) is a native `<button>` or `<a>` with no arrow handler — sequential Tab only.
Disabled items are removed from the toolbar tab order (`focusableWhenDisabled={false}`). A disabled href item keeps `role="link"` and `aria-disabled` but omits `href` and is `tabIndex={-1}`.
selected: Active is `aria-current="page"` plus `[data-active]`. It is a current-route marker, not a hover/press fill — `.item[data-active]` sets no background.

The label steps to `--{Role}-High` (via `--_bn-label-active`). The icon steps to `--{Role}-TintedA11y` (via `--_bn-icon-active`) and `Icon` emphasis flips from `low` to `tintedA11y`. On `appearance="neutral"`, TintedA11y would match inactive Low, so the active icon uses `--{Role}-High` instead and tracks the label.
If `activeIcon` is passed, that glyph replaces `icon` while active (filled-vs-outline convention). Font weight stays `--Label-FontWeight-Medium` in both states, so the row does not shift.
Parent `value` wins over this item's `active` prop whenever BottomNavigation has a selection.
disabled: `[data-disabled]` dims the item to `--Disabled-Opacity`, sets `cursor: not-allowed` and `pointer-events: none`, and suppresses hover fill, pressed fill, and the icon scale-up.
A disabled button is natively `disabled`. A disabled href item is still an `<a>` with `role="link"` and `aria-disabled="true"` but no `href`, so it cannot navigate.
Because `pointer-events: none` is set, the `not-allowed` cursor is not observable — the pointer shows the parent's cursor. This is the known system-wide gap (docs/design/disabled-states.md).
touch: On touch-only devices the hover pill never applies; the pressed inner fill plus the 14% icon scale-up are the entire tap response.
`.itemInner` cannot intercept the tap (`pointer-events: none`), so the hit target is the full column at `--Spacing-14` (icon-only), `--Spacing-16` (1-line), or `--Spacing-18` (2-line).
